# Ellis Services Group — Perth

> Ellis Services Group's Perth office provides handyman repairs and property maintenance across metropolitan Perth. These selected English and Simplified Chinese pages explain services, assessment enquiries, documented repairs and practical maintenance guidance. Ellis 珀斯办事处提供家居维修与物业维护；以下为精选的中英文公开资料。

## English services

- [Home repairs and maintenance](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/): Overview of the local team, repair services and on-site assessment with a written work plan and quote.
- [Home repair and maintenance services](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/services/): Service directory for household repairs, maintenance and specialist property work.
- [Odd jobs and handyman repairs](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/services/handyman-interiors-appliance-repairs/handymen/): Household fittings, furniture assembly and small maintenance tasks, with details available in expandable service cards.
- [Property maintenance](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/services/property-maintenance/): Maintenance plans, included services, workflow, charging arrangements, aftercare and contact information.
- [Door repairs](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/services/doors-windows-glass-screens/door-repairs/): Assessment of rubbing hinged doors, hinges, latches and frames before agreeing adjustment, repair or replacement.
- [Cabinet, drawer and wardrobe repairs](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/services/handyman-interiors-appliance-repairs/cabinet-wardrobe-repairs/): Loose hinges, drawer runners and wardrobe hardware, including alignment, board condition and compatible replacement parts.
- [Gyprock, wall and ceiling repairs](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/services/handyman-interiors-appliance-repairs/plasterers/): Patching damaged wall and ceiling linings, with backing, surface preparation and finishing scope assessed separately.

## 中文服务

- [家居维修与日常维护](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/zh/): 介绍本地团队、维修服务、现场评估及书面工作方案与报价。
- [房屋维修与物业维护服务目录](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/zh/services/): 按类别查找家庭维修、日常维护及专业物业工作。
- [零散小修与家居维修](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/zh/services/handyman-interiors-appliance-repairs/handymen/): 家居固定件、家具组装与小型维护，展开服务卡片可查看详细范围。
- [物业维修与日常维护](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/zh/services/property-maintenance/): 说明服务方案、包含项目、工作流程、收费安排、售后维护及联系方式。
- [门、门框与门五金维修](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/zh/services/doors-windows-glass-screens/door-repairs/): 检查门擦碰、铰链、门闩与门框，再确认调整、维修或更换范围。
- [橱柜、抽屉与衣柜维修](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/zh/services/handyman-interiors-appliance-repairs/cabinet-wardrobe-repairs/): 涵盖松动铰链、抽屉滑轨与衣柜五金，并检查柜板、对齐及配件兼容性。
- [石膏板、墙面与天花板修补](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/zh/services/handyman-interiors-appliance-repairs/plasterers/): 说明受损墙面和天花板修补，以及背衬、基层准备与饰面范围的评估。

## Company, service areas and enquiries

- [Service areas](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/areas/): Regional service directory; provide the actual suburb or postcode and repair details to confirm assessment arrangements.
- [About Ellis](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/about/): Perth office, local repair team, service process and company registration information.
- [Contact and assessment enquiries](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/contact/): Submit the task, location and contact details to arrange an assessment and written repair scope; photos are optional.

## 公司、服务地区与咨询

- [服务地区](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/zh/areas/): 按区域查找服务入口，提供实际城区或邮编及维修内容，以确认评估安排。
- [关于 Ellis](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/zh/about/): 介绍珀斯办事处、本地维修团队、服务流程与公司注册资料。
- [联系与现场评估咨询](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/zh/contact/): 提供工作内容、地点与联系方式，安排评估及书面维修范围；照片可自愿提供。

## Repair examples

- [Clothesline bracket repair in Canning](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/projects/clothesline-bracket-repair-canning/): Documented repair of a damaged bracket on an existing wall-mounted clothesline, rather than a new clothesline installation.
- [Drawer runner replacement in the Southern Corridor](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/projects/drawer-runner-replacement-southern-corridor/): Documented replacement of damaged runners on an existing drawer, with scope and outcome notes.

## 维修案例

- [Canning 晾衣架支架维修](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/zh/projects/clothesline-bracket-repair-canning/): 记录现有壁挂晾衣架受损支架的维修，而非安装全新晾衣架。
- [南部走廊地区抽屉滑轨更换](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/zh/projects/drawer-runner-replacement-southern-corridor/): 记录现有抽屉受损滑轨的更换，并说明工作范围与结果。

## Practical repair and booking guides

- [Cupboard door off its hinge: cabinet repairs](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/guides/cupboard-hinges-drawer-runners-repair-guide/): Distinguish worn hinges or runners from damaged cabinet boards before choosing compatible parts or requesting a repair.
- [Door rubbing after new carpet: door repair guide](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/guides/sticking-doors-windows-repair-guide/): Compare floor clearance, hinge alignment, swollen timber and sliding-door hardware before deciding on repairs.
- [Moving in with flat-pack furniture: handyman quotes](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/guides/prepare-before-home-repair-quote/): Prepare furniture models, missing-part details and a mixed repair list for a clear written quotation scope.

## 实用维修与预约指南

- [橱柜门铰链脱落怎么办？橱柜维修指南](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/zh/guides/cupboard-hinges-drawer-runners-repair-guide/): 区分铰链、滑轨磨损与柜板损坏，再选择兼容配件或提出维修需求。
- [换地毯后门擦地：门维修指南](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/zh/guides/sticking-doors-windows-repair-guide/): 比较地面间隙、铰链对齐、木材膨胀与推拉门五金问题，再决定维修方式。
- [搬家时需要家具组装：杂工维修报价指南](https://www.perthhandymate.com.au/zh/guides/prepare-before-home-repair-quote/): 整理家具型号、缺件说明与混合维修清单，形成便于核对的书面报价范围。
